competitions.result: Fourth round — lost 3–2 away to Oldham Athletic.
Fourth round — lost 3–1 at home to Swansea City.
Europa League round of 32 — eliminated by Zenit St Petersburg after a 3–3 aggregate draw.

out.note: Retired at the end of the campaign.

overview: Liverpool finished seventh in the Premier League with 61 points in Brendan Rodgers’ first season after arriving from Swansea City. Their first league win came in the sixth match, a 5–2 victory at Norwich. Luis Suárez scored 30 competitive goals, while January arrivals Daniel Sturridge and Philippe Coutinho added 11 and three respectively.

Oldham Athletic ended the FA Cup run in the fourth round, Swansea knocked Liverpool out of the League Cup, and Zenit St Petersburg eliminated them from the Europa League. Suárez received a ten-match ban for biting Chelsea’s Branislav Ivanović in April. Jamie Carragher retired at the end of the season after 737 appearances for the club.
Beyond the pitch, the Hillsborough Independent Panel published its report on 12 September 2012. Its findings made clear that supporters had not caused the disaster.

The Hillsborough paragraph reports the 2012 panel’s finding. It does not conflate that report with the later inquest verdict or imply that the families’ campaign ended then.
Suárez’s ten-match suspension extended beyond this campaign; it is not described as ten missed matches within 2012–13. The primary decision establishes the admitted biting offence.

Carragher’s retirement closes his playing career here. Carroll’s loan and Sahin’s loan termination are distinguished from permanent sales. Other reserve moves and unverified destinations are omitted from the selected transfer list.
